newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-KHUMALO RETURNS TO SOUTH AFRICAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KHUMALO RETURNS TO SOUTH AFRICAN SQUAD.

text.p: South Africa called up two uncapped players and restored top midfielder Doctor Khumalo to their squad for the World Cup qualifier against Congo in Pointe Noire on April 6.

Coach Clive Barker recalled the American-based Khumalo after dropping him for the last qualifying match aginst Zambia in January and also named defender Gavin Lane and striker George Koumantarakis in his squad for the first time.

Khumalo, who plays in Major League Soccer in the U.S. for Columbus Crew, was left out in January after a mediocre season but recalled in the wake of improved performances while on a short loan to South African club Kaizer Chiefs last month.
He was one of the country's heroes in last year's African Nations' Cup final victory.

Koumantarakis, who was born in Greece but capped by South Africa at junior level, is the leading goalscorer in the South African Premier Soccer League while Lane, who plays for former African club champions Orlando Pirates, comes into the squad as defensive cover.
Mark Fish, who plays for Lazio in Italy's Serie A, returns after suspension and is one of nine foreign-based players in the 19-man squad.

Barker has also included Sizwe Motaung and David Nyathi of Spanish club Tenerife even though the pair will be needed for a UEFA Cup semifinal, first leg against Schalke of Germany two days after the match in the Congo.
Goalkeepers: Mark Anderson (Umtata Bucks), Andre Arendse (Cape Town Spurs)
Defenders: Mark Fish (Lazio, Italy), Gavin Lane (Orlando Pirates), Sizwe Motaung, David Nyathi (both Tenerife, Spain), Lucas Radebe (Leeds United, England), Neil Tovey (Kaizer Chiefs)

Midfielders: Linda Buthelezi (Mamelodi Sundowns), Doctor Khumalo (Columbus Crew, U.S.), John Moeti, Helman Mkhalele (both Orlando Pirates), John Moshoeu (Kocaelispor, Turkey), Dumisa Ngobe (Orlando Pirates), Eric Tinkler (Cagliari, Italy)
Strikers: Brendan Augustine (Linzer ASK, Austria), Shaun Bartlett (Columbus Crew, U.S.), George Koumantarakis (Manning Rangers), Jerry Sikhosana (Orlando Pirates).
